definition_zh: v. 宣扬；炫示；精确描绘纹章；n. 纹章；纹章描述
definition_en: to proclaim widely and conspicuously, or a heraldic coat of arms
core_image: 把家徽漆在大门正中最显眼处
scene: 得胜的骑士把新家徽漆上城门，路人纷纷围观。The team's victory was blazoned across every front page.
sceneCN: 这里 blazon 是「大肆宣扬」（第 1 个义项：以醒目方式广而告之）；句意是该队的胜利被登上了所有头版。

derivatives.zh: em- 加 blazon，义为「饰以纹章；醒目地装饰」
emblazon 加 -ment，义为「纹章装饰；醒目标示」

senses.title: To proclaim conspicuously
senses.definition: to announce something in a very public, eye-catching way
senses.definitionCN: 以极公开、夺目的方式宣布某事
senses.example: The team's victory was blazoned across every front page.
senses.exampleCN: 该队的胜利被登上了所有头版。
senses.why: Heraldry displayed arms in the most visible place, and the verb keeps that visibility.
senses.whyCN: 纹章学把家徽置于最显眼处，动词保留了这份「显眼」。

senses.title: To describe arms in heraldic terms
senses.definition: to record a coat of arms in the precise language of heraldry
senses.definitionCN: 以纹章学的精确语言记录一枚纹章
senses.example: The officer blazoned the new grant of arms.
senses.exampleCN: 纹章官用规范术语登记了新授的纹章。
senses.why: The noun named both the shield and its official verbal description.
senses.whyCN: 名词既指盾徽本身，也指其官方的文字描述。

senses.title: A coat of arms
senses.definition: a heraldic shield or emblem of a family
senses.example: The blazon above the gate showed three lions.
senses.exampleCN: 门楣上的纹章绘着三头狮子。
senses.why: The display on the shield is the emblem's home ground.
senses.whyCN: 盾面上的展示正是纹章的本源所在。

senses.title: To decorate with heraldic designs
senses.definition: to adorn something with heraldic or showy devices
senses.definitionCN: 以纹章或炫目图案装饰某物
senses.example: Knights blazoned their shields before the tournament.
senses.exampleCN: 骑士们在比武前给盾牌绘上纹章。
senses.why: Emblazon is the common form, but blazon alone once carried this sense.
senses.whyCN: 今通用 emblazon，但 blazon 本身也曾承担此义。

senses.title: An ostentatious display
senses.definition: showy, conspicuous display of rank or wealth
senses.definitionCN: 对身份或财富的张扬炫示
senses.example: Their wealth was a constant blazon.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的财富是一面永不收起的炫耀旗帜。
senses.why: Arms on display were rank made visible; the noun keeps the showing-off.
senses.whyCN: 陈列的纹章是可视化的等级，名词保留了这份炫耀。

senses.title: A wide-ranging official proclamation
senses.definition: a formal, public announcement spread widely
senses.example: The news was blazoned by the town criers.
senses.exampleCN: 这一消息经镇上公告员广而告之。
senses.why: Public display and public speech were one act in the herald's office.
senses.whyCN: 在纹章官的职司中，公开陈列与公开宣告本为一体。

senses.title: Widely known marks of identity
senses.definition: the publicly recognized symbols of a person or group
senses.definitionCN: 个人或群体公开可辨的象征符号
senses.example: The white coat is the blazon of the medical profession.
senses.exampleCN: 白大褂是医疗行业的醒目标志。
senses.why: Emblems tell strangers who you are before speech begins.
senses.whyCN: 象征在开口之前便告知陌生人你是谁。

senses.title: To set forth in triumphant detail
senses.titleCN: 以胜利者的姿态详细宣告
senses.definition: to set out facts or achievements with triumphant emphasis
senses.definitionCN: 以得意而醒目的方式陈述事实或成就
senses.example: The company blazoned its quarterly record to investors.
senses.exampleCN: 公司向投资者高调宣扬其季度业绩。
senses.why: Victory shields were displayed first; triumphant announcing inherits the gesture.
senses.whyCN: 凯旋的盾徽先于言辞陈列，得胜的宣告承袭了这一姿态。

intro.en: Blazon likely comes through Anglo-French blason, shield or emblem.
intro.cn: blazon 一般认为经盎格鲁-法语 blason「盾徽」而来。

items.en: perhaps from a Germanic word for shield, via Frankish blason; origin uncertain.
items.cn: 或出自日耳曼语中表示「盾」的词，经法兰克语 blason 传入；来源不确定。

items.en: blason meant shield, coat of arms, and its description.
items.cn: 盎格鲁-法语 blason 兼指盾、纹章及其文字描述。

items.en: English borrowed blason for both the emblem and its formal description.
items.cn: 英语于 14 世纪借入，兼指纹章及其规范描述。

items.en: the verb grew the sense of proclaiming or displaying conspicuously.
items.cn: 16 世纪动词义发展为「醒目地宣扬、展示」。

items.en: emblazon now dominates decoration; blazon remains for proclaiming and heraldry.
items.cn: 今装饰义主要由 emblazon 承担；blazon 保留「宣扬」与纹章义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the blazon- root and sound-alikes; the near-meaning group gathers proclaiming words.
note.cn: 形近组含 blazon- 同根与音近词；近义组收宣扬类词。

entries.definitionCN: 饰以纹章；醒目装饰——同根加前缀
炽烈的——与 blaze 混淆
厚颜的——拼写相近，词源不同

normalIntro.en: Blazon once named both the shield and its written description; now it means to display proudly.
normalIntro.cn: blazon 曾兼指盾徽及其文字描述，今指炫耀式展示。

normal.en: Emblazon is the decorated form of the idea.
normal.cn: emblazon 是这一概念的「装饰版」。

normal.en: Heraldry students still blazon coats of arms.
normal.cn: 纹章学学习者至今仍用 blazon 描述纹章。

normal.en: Passive blazoned across the headlines is common.
normal.cn: 常见被动式 blazoned across the headlines。

normal.en: The noun can mean a coat of arms.
It carries a showy, proud tone.
normal.cn: 它带有张扬得意的语气。

abstract.en: See a knight's crest painted larger than the castle gate.
abstract.cn: 看骑士的纹章漆得比城门还大。

abstract.en: Hear a town crier shouting news from corner to corner.
abstract.cn: 听公告员在街角之间高声传讯。

abstract.en: Picture your name in ten-centimetre letters across the front page.
abstract.cn: 想象你的名字以十厘米大字印满头版。

examples.en: The team's victory was blazoned across every front page.
examples.cn: 该队的胜利被登上了所有头版。

examples.en: The officer blazoned the new grant of arms.
examples.cn: 纹章官用规范术语登记了新授的纹章。

examples.en: The blazon above the gate showed three lions.
examples.cn: 门楣上的纹章绘着三头狮子。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不雷ton」——徽章挂门口，声不惊人死不休，就怕你不看见。

root: 一般认为经盎格鲁-法语 blason「盾、纹章」而来，更早或出自日耳曼语表「盾」之词（经法兰克语，来源不确定）；14 世纪进入英语，兼指纹章及其文字描述；16 世纪衍生「醒目宣扬」的动词义。

sensesIntro.en: From painting arms on gates to headlines on screens, blazon means display that insists on being seen.
sensesIntro.cn: 从城门上的家徽到屏幕上的头条，blazon 指坚持要被看见的展示。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a family crest painted over the widest gate
core.cn: 核心意象：漆在最宽城门上的家族纹章

branches.en: The heraldic art and its language

intro.en: Blazon builds a small heraldic family.
intro.cn: blazon 构成一个小的纹章词族。

latinIntro.en: French and Germanic chain, no Latin core.
latinIntro.cn: 法语与日耳曼的传递链，无拉丁核心。
